decisions.state_note: o000: White window approximately x9–73, y126–190; small dark fragment touches its upper-right edge. Shape mostly unobserved; no detections.

o002: Window x41–105, y94–158 shows an upper dark arm near x55–66 bending right into a thick band around y112–129 that continues past the right edge. Detector reports horizontal band and up-to-right elbow; overall digit unknown.

o007: Window x73–137, y94–158 shows a dark band around y110–129 joining the upright at x126–136. Detector reports horizontal band. Upper continuation remains unseen.

o008: Window x73–137, y62–126 shows white above a dark horizontal band near y110–125, with dark continuation along the right edge and a small dark fragment at upper-left. Detector supports horizontal band; upper structure remains unknown.
o009: Window x73–137, y30–94 is mostly white, with a small dark fragment at left near y65–79 and a narrow dark strip at right near y65–93. No detections; upper connections remain unknown.
